agyos_skill.intent: Psychological compatibility matching — find cofounders, collaborators, and friends through validated psychometrics
agyos_skill.instructions: Viboscope helps find compatible people — cofounders, project partners, friends, romantic partners — through deep psychological compatibility matching. It builds a profile across 10 validated dimensions and calculates mathematical compatibility with other users. - Use when looking for a cofounder or project collaborator - Use when wanting to find people with compatible work style and values - Use when checking compatibility with a specific person via invite link ```bash curl -fsS https://viboscope.com/api/v1/skill -o viboscope.md ``` Save to your platform's skills directory. The skill guides a 5-minute onboarding that builds a psychological profile using: - AI assistant portrait (fastest — 2 min for 90%+ profile) - 5 validated questionnaires (Big Five, Values, Attachment, Conflict, Work Style) - Context scan from workspace files Search across 7 contexts: business, romantic, friendship, professional, intellectual, hobby, general. Results include percentage scores and human-readable explanations of why you match. Tell your AI agent: "Install Viboscope and find me a cofounder" The agent will guide you through profiling, then search for business-compatible matches with aligned values and complementary work styles. Share your invite link: `viboscope.com/match/@your_nick` When someone opens it with their AI agent, both see a compatibility breakdown. - Website: https://viboscope.com - GitHub: https://github.com/ivankoriako/viboscope - API: https://viboscope.com/api/v1 - Use this skill only when the task clearly matches the scope described above. - Do not treat the output as a substitute for environment-specific validation, testing, or expert review. - Stop and ask for clarification if required inputs, permissions, safety boundaries, or success criteria are missing.
